newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business -April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business -April 30.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on April 30:
NEW YORK - Investors finally found a rally they could believe in. Stock and bond prices bounded sharply higher in trading across the board after new economic reports turned up few signs of inflation.
WASHINGTON - Choice Hotels Inc of Silver Spring, Md., will be divided into two companies.
WASHINGTON - Starting at midnight, Maryland residents will have to dial 10 digits -- area code plus number -- for all local telephone calls.

WASHINGTON - Senate Majority leader Trent Lott appeared to dampen hopes of reaching a balanced budget agreement this week when he declared it's "too late" for Republicans to support reducing inflation allowances for federal benefit programs.
